tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang 'bras bu shin tu che ba'i chu gtor gtong ba'i rim pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'khar ba dang / bse dang / lcags ma yin pa'i zangs dang / rdza sogs las byas pa'i snod dri ma med pa'i nang chu gtsang gis bkang ba la/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar te dkar gsum stob ma chung tsam blugs pa la/ phye gtsang ma ji ltar rigs pa btab/ gzhan yang kan+da ka ri/ dbang lag sle tres/ rgya mtsho lbu ba/ shu dag dkar po ste sman lnga/ nas/ gro/ sran dkar/ til/ so ba ste 'bru lnga/ gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu men/ mu tig ste rin po che lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gur gum dza ti/ ga pur te dri lnga ste de rnams zhib par btags la btab/ gzhan yang dar tshon sna tshogs pa dang / dbyar yin na me tog sna tshogs pa'ang bsdus te btab pa bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum gyi rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ wa gi shwa ri mum̐/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems mum̐ ser po'i mthar oṃ wa gi shwa ri mum̐ gyis g.yas su bskor ba de yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri'i yu ba mum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus ral gri la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab gyi ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po de zhu ste tshangs bug nas thim pas lus kyi nang gang bas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje'i go cha gyon par gyur/ ces brjod la/ oṃ wa gi shwa ri mum̐/ zhes brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas la/ de nas/ oṃ ar+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhā/ ting shags dkrol te/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib byang zhing dag pa dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas gong du bshams pa'i yo byad rnams la dmigs nas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po 'khar sil dang / lhung bzed bsnams pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du a dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pa mchod pa'i yo byad la phog pas mchod pa'i nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur/ ces dang / lag pa khog stong du sbyar sor mo rnams rtse sprad pa chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho ham̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni/ chu snyog ma can la nor bu rin po che bcug pas snyog ma dwangs pa bzhin du bsgom mo/ /yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gyi mdzod spur khaṃ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pa yo byad la phog pas gtor ma'i yo byad rnams 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon lnga'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khyon gang bar gyur/

ces dang / lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo las sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs bar ma bcag pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya smin mtshams su bcas la/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣ+ya bh+ya/ sarba tha kham̐ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i mam̐ ga ga na kham̐ swāhā/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni/ nor bu gcig las dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung ba bzhin du bsgom mo/ /yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dmar po g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la bsgrengs pa'i ljags steng du a dmar las 'od zer 'phros pa yo byad la phog pas gtor ma'i yo byad rnams mgron so so'i lus kyi nad dang sems kyi zug rngu zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces dang lag pa gnyis thal mo las gung mo gnyis kyi rgyab mdzub mo gnyis kha phye la sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya khar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni sman 'chi med lta bu ste skye bo kun gyi gsos byed par bsam pa yin no/ /yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'i g.yas pa'i mdzub mo la bh+rum̐ kha dog sna tshogs pa de las 'od zer 'phros pa gtor ma'i yo byad la phog pas yo byad thams cad 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis gang ba dang / sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams char gyi rgyun bzhin du 'bab par gyur/ ces dang / lag pa g.yas pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag byas pa rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/

oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni dbul pos nor gyi gter rnyed na longs spyod pa'i dbang thob pa bzhin du bsgom mo/ /yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'i phyag mthil du zla ba'i steng du ha ljang khu las 'od zer 'phros pa rang gi lus dang gtor ma'i yo byad la phog pas rang gi lus zhing gi rdul phra dang mnyam par gyur nas 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab cing / gtor ma'i yo byad rnams mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid bzhin du tshim zhing 'thab rtsod zhi nas mthun pa'i bsam pas rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur/ ces dang / lag pa g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa pang du bzhag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgrengs pa'i sdigs mdzub bstan pa ye shes skar zla'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa ba lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa mahā ma ni du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la na swāhā zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni/ rtswa kha'i zil ba lta bu ste/ rtswa che na zil pa che/ rtswa chung na zil pa chung ba bzhin du bsgom mo/ /yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsgrengs pa'i spyi bor dza dmar po las 'od zer 'phros pa gtor ma'i yo byad la phog yo byad rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing yo byad de dag srid zhi'i mgron/ yon tan gyi mgron/ lan chags kyi mgron rnams kyis bzhes shing khyer bas mnyes te dam tshig dbang gis bdag la srung skyobs mdzad nas bar chad zhi ba dang / sems can gyi don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad par gyur/ ces dang / lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams la mthe bong gnyis gshibs pa spyi bo'i thad kar skor ba dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/

na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nam̐ gra he shwa ri pra pañdza ti mahā sa ma ya na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes lan bdun brjod/ dmigs pa'i dpe ni rdo khab len lta bu ste/ rdo khab len gyis lcags thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus pa bzhin du bsgom mo/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams phyogs bcur bstan par yid kyis bsam zhing / sngags rnams so sor rdzogs pa dang / se gol re tog go /de nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rtsa ba'i bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mgron gyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ting shags dkrol zhing / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /na mo bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /sems can rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gi na/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la/ /'khor dang bcas pa ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos dang / /lha srin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /dge rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /zhes spyan drangs pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su gtor mgron rnams byon nas sprin 'thib pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam la/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwam̐/ zhes pas so so la gdan phul bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wa ra oṃ ar+gham̐ nas/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/

de nas gtor ma bsngo ba dngos ni/ snying khar thal mo sbyar la 'di skad ces pa bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mthu dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i byin rlabs kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ni srid zhi'i mgron du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan thos la sogs pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /de rnams kyi pho brang dang gzhal yas khang du kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig yon tan gyi mgron du gyur pa mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / yang dag shes dang rgyal ba khyu mchog la sogs pa phyogs mtshams srung bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gnod sbyin mthu bo che sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dpal ha ri ka dang / pañtsi ka la sogs te gtsug lag khang gi srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la mngon par dad pa'i lha klu gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin nam mkha' lding mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po btsun mo sras dang 'bangs su bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /de rnams kyi pho brang du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bar snang la char bzhin babs/ sa gzhi la lo tog bzhin skyes/ mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs nas dgyes rab kyi mchog mnyes rab kyi phul thob par gyur cig khyed rnams la 'phrin las dang snyan gsan du gsol ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas shing /

bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan pa dang / 'phrin las rab tu rgyas shing bstan pa dang bar chad thams cad bzlog pa dang zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi dam pa chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skyes gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i srid pa'i rtse mo nas dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /gsol lo/ bsngo 'o/ /mgron no/ /de dag so so'i spyan lam du mnga' rigs dang / longs spyod ci la ci dges gang la gang 'dul chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod ci 'dod thob par gyur cig yul phyogs kyi lha mgon klu mgon du gyur pa'i sa bdag lha klu rnams la'ang sbyin no/ so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par thob par gyur cig lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing mi 'dod pa skyed par byed pa rnams dang / khyad par bdag cag gi tshe sngon gyi lan chags bu lon dang sha 'khon du gnyer ba rnams la sbyin no/ /gnod sems zhi nas phan bde bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces dang / ting shags dkrol/ gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po 'di/ /chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dkon mchog yon tan dpag med che ba dang / /snying po phyag rgya nges pa'i dam tshig dang / /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi grub pa dang / /bdag gi smon lam shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyi/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gter chen gyur pa 'di/ /mchod nas bla ma khyed kyi pho brang du/

/mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas shing bstims par smon/ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /kun kyang gnod pa rnams dang bral/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa'i/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /ma thogs par ni grub par shog /byol song gcig la gcig za ba'i/ /gnod pa de dag yongs mi 'byung / /yi dwags rnams la zas dang skom/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang / /mi zad rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsod nams 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ /de dag myur du zhi gyur cig /sa 'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang / /'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa/ /dge ba'i bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen po 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo gnyis med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes brjod la/ de ltar zang zing gi sbyin pas dbang po'i rgyud tshim/ chos kyi sbyin pas shes pa'i rgyud grol nas nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas gtan nas dag

bsod nams dang ye shes tshogs lhun gyis grub nas mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ ting shags dkrol la/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de'i bram ze de'ang / /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa rjes ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya༞ sogs lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing / oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams la/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir lhags pa yi/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /gang dag sa steng 'khod pa dang / /sa blar gyur ba gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta gats+tshaḥzhes dang / sum+bha ni la sogs pa drag sngags brjod cing rang rang gi gnas su dengs par bsam/ de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsam pas rang gi lus bsrung la/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs dang / bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs kyis dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i yo byad rnams klu gnas pa'i chu mig dang / 'gom mi 'chor ba'i sa gtsang sar dor ba gal che bas de bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/

/zhes chu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung gi gsal byed du sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i chu gtor gyi yi ge blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed la gzhi byas shing / der mi gsal ba rnams rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs kyi gsung rab nas bsdus te shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lug lo zla ba lnga pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi nub phyogs ljon shing yid 'ong rab tu rgyas pas yongs su bskor ba'i kun dga' ra ba de nyid du legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig yi ge pa yang rang nyid kyis bgyis pa lags so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 a myes zhabs/ chu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
